The method is low-rank compression, not ternarization; parameter ratio must not be confused with bits per weight or percentage storage retained under ternary packing.

ZeroQuant-V2 studies OPT and BLOOM weight and activation sensitivity, fine-grained quantization, and low-rank compensation of weight error. Its historical tested INT4 schemes did not uniformly restore original quality. LoRC is an added low-rank representation, and Appendix D separately discusses quantization-aware training. These findings motivate a counted residual baseline; they neither prove all contemporary quantizers fail nor demonstrate symmetric ternary conversion.

A block-aware activation objective is relevant to progressive conversion, but this evidence does not show training-free single-plane ternary recovery or compatibility with the existing native kernel.

INQ repeatedly partitions pretrained weights, quantizes a subset, and retrains the remaining subset to compensate, until conversion is complete. Its general alphabet is powers of two plus zero, with a ternary ResNet18 experiment. The evidence concerns ImageNet convolutional networks and includes retraining; it establishes historical precedence for progressive conversion, not feasibility for pretrained language-model experts under this project budget.
